name: Verdant Note
summary: At Camp Narache, the Verdant Note calls young tauren to seek Gart Mistrunner. Grull Hawkwind carries the summons on Gart’s behalf.

sections.title: A Summons to the Path
sections.body: On the Red Cloud Mesa, Grull Hawkwind gives young tauren a message from a messenger sent by Gart Mistrunner. The summons calls those with natural gifts to accept their responsibilities. It invites them into the ancient practice of tauren druidism and asks them to leave simple village errands behind for the balance of the plains.

sections.title: Voices of the Earthmother
sections.body: Gart Mistrunner warns that ancestral and natural spirits have grown restless across Mulgore. Tauren druids act as living avatars of nature and keep harmony with the Earthmother’s will despite rivalries far away. Night elves also practice druidic arts, but Gart says their pride blinds them to the tauren’s deep bond with the natural realm.

faq.answer: The Verdant Note calls young tauren druids to seek Gart Mistrunner at Camp Narache and begin learning the druidic arts.

faq.q: Who delivers the note to the player?
faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind gives the note to the young druid and says a messenger sent by Gart Mistrunner was looking for them.

faq.q: Where can Gart Mistrunner be found?
faq.answer: Gart Mistrunner is at Camp Narache, beneath the shelter of its natural bluffs, where he trains novice tauren druids.

faq.q: Why does Gart Mistrunner warn against the night elves?
faq.answer: Gart Mistrunner says night elf pride blinds them to the tauren’s deep bond with nature. He urges his student to heed the Earthmother’s wisdom.

faq.q: Why are the spirits in Mulgore restless?
faq.answer: Gart Mistrunner senses ancestral and natural spirits stirring across Mulgore. Their unrest marks the new druid’s lifelong duty to keep balance in the wild.

faq.q: What ability does Gart teach next after completing this quest?
faq.answer: When the young druid reports to Gart Mistrunner, he becomes their trainer and promises to teach them the Earthmother’s gifts as they grow in wisdom.

angles.text: As a tauren, you inherit druidism as a sacred covenant rooted in devotion to the Earthmother.
As a druid, you begin learning to channel Azeroth’s wild energies and restless spirits.
As a member of the Horde, you join the tauren druids. They bridge the faction and Kalimdor’s natural mysteries while balancing its martial strength.
